crossRefs.note: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh…
For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken…
“God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand…

people.name: Zobah

translations.web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
translations.bsb: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of their men.
translations.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
